paragraphs: Rabbi Acha, son of Rav Huna, [Berakhot 32a](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.32a.12).

notes.text: [Hyman, vol. I, p. 336](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/3/3f/Aaron_Hyman._Toldoth_Tannaim_veAmoraim._I._1910.pdf#page=367) reads ר׳ אחא, “Rabbi Acha,” beside the supplied רק אחא. The consulted Berakhot calls both Acha and Chiyya Rav and specifies Rav Huna as father. Shabbat names Avin without a title in these notices. [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=156&lang=en) discusses the variant titles for Avin and Huna.
